The pearl decay curve is applied at each close, pigment records the drop, and quartz recomputes standing from replay. Standing decays sharply after 6 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. A 500 account operation therefore ties up 27 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
